unbound.transfer.withdraw: Intentionally unbound. Irreversible and owner-only; the agent refuses it before binding is consulted. Only wallet_withdrawHistory (read) is exposed by the surface — no withdraw-submit tool.

notes: Tool names are the bare Agent OS tools/list identifiers. This MCP client exposes them under the prefix in `toolNamePrefix` (e.g. mcp__binance-mcp-server__spot_newOrder); the transport that AFTERIMAGE wires decides which form it forwards.

`bindings` maps AFTERIMAGE capability ids (packages/core/src/capabilities.ts) to live tool names resolved from an authenticated tools/list. 13 of 14 capabilities are bound; transfer.withdraw is intentionally owner-only and stays unbound, so bindingReport() reports `partial` by design.

market.quote binds to spot_ticker24hr with type=FULL so bid/ask are present. account.portfolio uses wallet_queryUserWalletBalance with a quoteAsset for valued totals. order.history binds to spot_myTrades because no all-orders endpoint is exposed; myTrades is the fill/reconciliation source.

Binding a capability does not enable execution on its own: the adapter still requires a wired MCP transport and, for writes, a per-action owner approval token. No user funds were accessed and no live order was placed while recording this manifest.
